description: If an illegal alien is arrested, local authorities must turn him/her over to ICE. My SB 1055 is an extension of state law. It restores the rule of law. Here is my explanation notwithstanding the rude, loud, and disruptive audience. Watch now:
title: Sen. Wendy Rogers: EVERY illegal alien arrested Should be turned over to ICE. SB 1055 will do that. | Wendy Rogers
